ai_rubric.Fixed-Point Iteration: Substitution into $x_{n+1}=\pi-\sin^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{e^{-x_n/2}+1}\right)$ gives consecutive iterates $2.3217\to2.2760\to2.2824$, converging to $x_1=2$, $x_2=2.3217$, $x_3=2.2760$, $x_4=2.2824$, so the root is $2.28$ (2 d.p.).
